question: Which branch of economics deals with the depletion of natural resources stock and pollution, which are a result of rapid economic development?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Environmental Economics**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Environmental Economics deals with the depletion of natural resources stock and pollution, which are a result of rapid economic development**__.

 __
 
• It conducts **theoretical or empirical studies** of the economic impacts of **national or local environmental policies** around the world.
 
• Some specific issues include the costs and benefits of alternative environmental policies to combat air pollution, water quality, solid waste, and global warming.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Developmental Economics -**

 
 
• it is a **branch of economics** that focuses on improving fiscal, economic, and social conditions in developing countries.
 
• it is mainly focused such as **health, education, working conditions, domestic and international policies**, and market conditions.
 
 
 
• **International Economics -**
 
 
• It is concerned with all those economic deals which are done **outside the borders of the country.**​
 
 
 
• **Public Economics -**
 
 
• It is based on the** principle of welfare economics **and is ultimately used as a tool to** improve social welfare.**​
 
 
 
• **​Adam Smith** is known as** 'Father of economics'.**
